note.title: Note
note.default: Structural-gap rule: at least three consecutive terms with a confusion share >= 0.60 and sufficient lecture volume. This is an observed-signal pattern, not a measurement of comprehension.

unique_semantics.title: Unique Semantics
unique_semantics.default: Distinct temporary participants observed in this minute; never the sum of per-bucket unique counts.

note.title: Note
note.default: Signal counts are measured events. They are not a comprehension rate and low activity does not prove understanding.

interpretation_note.title: Interpretation Note
interpretation_note.default: These are measured participation signals and detected time windows. They do not measure learning outcomes and cannot establish that everyone understood.
